description: A cream canvas tote bag with dark straps sits on a pink surface, and a small pink plush toy lies to the right. The left hand and right hand pull the tote upright and spread its opening wide into a two-hand object, with the right hand reaching down inside as the left hand steadies the rim, then both hands release and the right hand lifts the pink plush and drops it into the open bag as a right-hand object.
